raw_site_text: 26 municipal and provincial PESOs located in three regions: National Capital Region (NCR), Region III on the island of Luzon, and Region XI in Mindanao
justification: Study PESOs are in NCR, Region III and Region XI; only NCR maps to an admissible unit (Metropolitan Manila).
note: Incomplete list: Region III (Luzon) and Region XI (Mindanao) provinces are not named in the text, so only Metropolitan Manila is coded.
